vocabulary.extension_rule: a new origin requires a contract version bump; existing origins never change meaning

defaults.rule: USER_MANUAL is assigned only on the UI order path, explicitly

propagation.assigned_at: order intent, before the engine sees it
propagation.funding_rule: FUNDING inherits the origin of the position it accrues against
propagation.liquidation_rule: LIQUIDATION inherits the origin of the position it closes; being liquidated does not change who opened it
propagation.tape_rule: the COMMAND record carries origin so replay restores it; storing it only in the ledger loses it on rebuild

backward_compatibility.reason: ledger.append accepts arbitrary payload keys, so adding one is additive

analytics_separation.equity_curve_rule: drawdown and equity are computed after the origin filter, not before

test_policy.preferred: isolated instance on a separate port and run directory
test_policy.if_production_unavoidable: an explicit TEST origin is mandatory
test_policy.symmetry_rule: do not assume an existing trade is a developer test, and do not assume it is a user trade either

known_violation.note: reported for approval; production code was not modified
